snippet.title: PHOTOMALY | Release Date | Ready for Collection July 21st
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/4286120/Photomaly/

Photomaly is a PSX-style first-person horror job sim, where players take over the management of their late father's photography studio. Carry out photoshoots of strange customers, maintain your studio and keep an eye out for things that don’t seem quite right...
